rules.claim: The DocumentViewSet download action calls file_response(pk, request, "attachment").
The API exposes a per-document download URL containing the document primary key.
file_response resolves the request/root document, rejects an already returned HttpResponseForbidden, selects an effective file document, then calls serve_file.

The served representation uses the archive when original_requested(request) is false and the effective file document has an archive version; otherwise the original representation is selected by this argument.

dependencies.reason: The download file selection depends on the request/root resolution and its authorization result; the shown body delegates this behavior to a helper.
The returned file document is selected by this helper after request/root resolution; its version-selection semantics are not shown in the current evidence.
The actual file response is delegated to serve_file with the selected document, archive flag, attachment disposition, and follow_formatting query parameter.
